title: Trust demands transparency: a cautionary note on misleading inference in pediatric acute appendicitis imaging meta-analysis
details: J Arredondo Montero - Pediatric Surgery International, 2025
abstract: Evidence-based medicine is only as reliable as the evidence upon which it rests. In the case of pediatric acute appendicitis—a condition affecting millions of children worldwide—diagnostic clarity is essential to avoid both under-and overtreatment …
